name: tag+bag

trigger.purpose: Preserve eligible source artifacts from this agent's accessible session in the central evidence catalogue, after rights, privacy, provenance and duplicate checks.

execution_boundary.actor: The current agent executes the workflow manually using only sources and tools available to that agent.
execution_boundary.session_access: Only this agent's currently accessible conversation messages and attachments; never claim access to other or hidden chats.
execution_boundary.preserve_existing_spill: The existing spill command remains facts-only and unchanged.

eligibility.owner_statement_rule: If an owner statement is recorded, identify it as an owner statement, cite its accessible message and keep it distinct from documentary evidence.
exclude: Private or third-party correspondence without explicit public-release authority
Personal data about living private people
Sources the agent cannot access or identify

workflow: Read the active bucklerfamily-estate repository guidance, current catalogue schema, relevant issue and branch state; never write to the retired cedwyn repository.
Retrieve the exact candidate artifact and record its source message or source URL and observed access date; if unavailable, report that exact dependency.
Search existing catalogue records by title and identifiers; when bytes are available, compute SHA-256 and compare file bytes before creating anything.
Check rights and public-release authority for the exact file, transcription and capture independently; do not infer permission or prohibition from the absence of a licence label.
Preserve unchanged original bytes only where public repository storage is authorized; record SHA-256, provenance, rights note, source/capture date and local path.

Create one current-schema catalogue record per distinct artifact, using separate description, transcript_status, transcript and interpretation fields and a local repository link where an authorized copy exists.

Use a real preview when available or an explicitly labelled placeholder; collapse faithful transcription by default below the description, preview and local file link; mark uncertain OCR; keep interpretation separate and evidence-bounded.
Work on a feature branch, read every write back, run available checks, and leave any PR unmerged and the production site unchanged pending the required preview and publication gate.
Report verified file and record URLs, hashes, test results, and each remaining artifact-specific blocker; never claim an unconfirmed write or invent a URL.

deduplication.byte_hash: SHA-256 of the exact retrieved bytes when available
deduplication.duplicate_action: Reuse the existing record and do not upload identical bytes as a new artifact.
deduplication.unknown_bytes: State that byte comparison was not possible; do not claim an exact-document match.

catalogue.local_file_link: Use the central repository copy only if that copy is authorized.
catalogue.transcription: Faithful, rights-permitted text; collapsed by default below description, preview and local file link; uncertain OCR marked explicitly.
catalogue.interpretation: Separate from transcription and limited to what cited evidence supports.
catalogue.web_capture: Record original source URL and capture timestamp; use a capture only when its reproduction is authorized.

rights.when_unclear: Do not publish the copy, full transcription or capture. Record a citation or metadata-only placeholder if the schema permits, then identify the rights-holder clarification needed.

failure_reporting.scope: A failure blocks only the artifact or operation that depends on it; continue independent safe work.
forbidden_claims: Claimed access to an unavailable chat
